## Main arguments by thread
### Dooku vs Maul (t2957 TPM, t2531 SoD)
- Pro-Dooku (Latham2000, Jake, HellfireUnit, ILS): Legends sources say Dooku > Maul outright: Insider #69 ("Count Dooku is more skillful than Maul"), Panel-to-Panel Vol 1 ("if anything deadlier than Maul"), Obi-Wan's Legacy of the Jedi thought that Dooku "completely overpowered" him in a way Maul hadn't. Dooku beat Jedi-era Mace in spars (Power of the Jedi Sourcebook; TCW Lightsaber Duels game line). Figurine Collection #12: "arguably the most skilled with a lightsaber" in the Temple. ILS (SoD): "Dooku should win in a scathing fight... The differences between them are marginal but just enough to grant Dooku a noticeable edge most of the time." ILS on style: the way through Dooku's guard is "overwhelming aggression, speed, power and unpredictability" (Anakin, Vos in Dark Disciple, Savage).
- Pro-Maul (O-Siri, SithSauce, Heathen): Maul has the athletic and physical edge and stamina; "Dooku probably holds the edge early but if it drags on Maul is only going to get sharper... Dooku is just going to get weaker" (O-Siri). Maul "perhaps second only" to Sidious (Shadow Hunter / Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels, TPM era). Heathen cites a Canon reference (Ultimate Star Wars / Beyond the Saga list) putting TPM Maul > ROTS Tyranus, and Lucas calling them roughly equal.
- Counter on the "second only" line (Latham2000): it's TPM-era and says "perhaps"; the canon list is a different continuity and can't be blended into a Legends thread (site standard rule = Legends).
- SoD side debate: in Son of Dathomir, a drained Dooku plus a fresh Maul join the Sidious vs Talzin lightning clash and it becomes lopsided; long argument (ILS, Quorian Debatist, Azronger) over whether Talzin was weakened by the ritual, so no clean Dooku-vs-Maul read from it.
- Tally (rough): t2957 split, slight Maul lean among voters; t2531 lean Dooku among the posters who argued.

### Dooku vs Yoda (t2938, inside t2957)
- Lucas (AOTC commentary/BTS): Yoda and Dooku "equal to each other" at Geonosis in the Force. Latham2000 found the AOTC diorama text: "the two combatants exhibited near equal strength in the Force."
- CuckedCurry: equality is only in what was shown; Yoda only deflected and never went on the offense, and Dark Rendezvous shows Yoda "definitively superior" later. BreakofDawn: same level with "a small edge" to Yoda. 
- t2938 (ROTS Dooku vs AOTC Yoda): split, no sources posted.

### Dooku vs Vader (t187 sabers, t472 Mustafar Vader)
- Pro-Vader: Gillard puts ROTS Anakin at 9 and Dooku at 8; Anakin beat Dooku on the Invisible Hand; Vader's strength, stamina, Form V; Vader "far more formidable" by ESB and "more deadly invincibility than ever" in ROTJ (novel, per Azronger); "Barring psychological tactics The Count doesn't have a win condition. He's an 8 to Vader's 9" (DC77).
- Pro-Dooku: technical skill and Makashi, instructor-level knowledge of all forms (O-Siri: "he'll get the measure of Vader's style in no time"), Dooku handled Grievous's strength; BreakofDawn: without prior knowledge Legends Vader "loses hard" in sabers.
- Tally: t472 strong Vader majority ("Vader creams", Vader in a good fight); t187 sabers split, Vader lean.

### Other
- Mustafar Obi-Wan vs AOTC Dooku: lean Obi-Wan ("This iteration of Kenobi matched Anakin in the Force", Corvinus). Azronger: AOTC Dooku < Ventress (canon-era claim, no source).
- ROTS Dooku vs Nihilus: Dooku (HellfireUnit: drain resistance from the Force Harvester/Ulic story, skill). Low-effort thread.
- Mace vs Ahsoka vs Dooku (Canon only): Windu wins per most; BreakofDawn: "The gap between canon Sidious and Dooku is pretty sizeable."

## What Grok agrees with after checking the notes
- Agree: Dooku > Maul in Legends, but not by much. The Legends statements (Insider #69, Panel-to-Panel, Legacy of the Jedi, Labyrinth's "minion" vs "equal" line) all point one way, and they're about the PT era. The stamina point is real (Wookieepedia lists age and stamina as Dooku's liabilities in long duels), so a long fight is closer.
- Agree: Yoda > Dooku. The AOTC novel has Yoda pushing him back, and Vjun ("Slowly, slowly, Dooku gave way"; Dooku: "There was always a chance you could overpower me") is the cleaner fair fight. Lucas's "equal" line is about the Force exchange only, and Dooku himself conceded the Force couldn't decide it.
- Partly agree on Vader: Mustafar-era Vader beats Dooku more often than not, because Anakin already did it on the Invisible Hand and Mustafar Anakin is stronger. I don't buy "Vader creams/stomps": the Invisible Hand fight was a real duel until Anakin's rage turn, and the Behpour and Naboo fights show Dooku surviving strength-based pressure.
- Disagree: "AOTC Dooku < Ventress" (no source, and AOTC/Clone Wars-era fights show Dooku beating her repeatedly). Disagree with blending the Canon "TPM Maul > ROTS Tyranus" list into a Legends verdict: keep it in a separate Canon note.
